name: zclass_cls_di_segments_grid_window
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentsInGridWindow scans the aggregate segment grid window, dispatches eligible area children through the segment-batch recursive walker, and handles clamped cells by temporarily offsetting segment endpoints and bounds before restoring source-space candidates.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI segment-batch source-cluster pass. The current implementation preserves the Binary Ninja-observed x/z grid projection, clamp offset, child flag gate, recursive dispatch, break-on-first check, and newly appended candidate correction behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x445f60 validates that ECX is the world node, EDX is the segment active-mask array, the function returns no meaningful value, reads zClass_WorldDataPartial grid fields from world->classData, projects g_DiSegmentBounds x/z extents with floor, scans the aggregate min/max grid window, skips outside cells when clampQueriesToBounds is zero, clamps outside cells when enabled, offsets g_DiPickPointArray segment endpoints and g_DiSegmentBounds x/z fields during clamped cell traversal, dispatches only children with flags 0x04 and 0x10 to BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentsRecursive(child, area->childCount + 1, activeMask), breaks on the global first-candidate flag, restores segment endpoints/bounds after clamped traversal, and subtracts the clamp offset from newly appended candidate hit x/z positions only.
